tracks.full_text: Good afternoon and welcome aboard this train to Ashedale. Our next stop is Bruxton, famous for being the birthplace of renowned painter Oliver Murray. As you may know, several of Mr. Murray's paintings hang in museums around the world. Please be advised that due to the short platform length, the doors of the last train car will not open. If you are in that car, you'll need to walk forward to exit the train. There will also be a short delay at this station while our new train crew comes on and gets situated. We apologize for any inconvenience.

To accommodate the new retail spaces for Rossi, participating Willoughby stores will start renovations in July.
